Cooling Plant Selector

Compare air-cooled chillers, free-cooling dry coolers, adiabatic coolers, cooling towers and hybrid dry coolers + towers for a data hall with liquid and air cooling loops, hour by hour over a full year.

InputsChange any value; results update instantly

1. Weather

Built-in cities use measured hourly weather (TMYx 2011–2025, main airport station) and ASHRAE 2025 design conditions, from climate.onebuilding.org. Upload your own EPW or CSV for a specific site.
Drop an .epw file (ASHRAE IWEC / TMY) or a CSV here, or click to choose
CSV format

One row per hour, 8,760 rows from 1 January 00:00, with a header row:

Month,Day,Hour,DryBulb_C,RH_pct,Pressure_Pa
1,1,0,17.1,64.9,101205
1,1,1,15.9,70.0,101205
  • Required: dry-bulb (°C) and one of RH (%), dew point (°C) or wet-bulb (°C).
  • Optional: month (1–12); station pressure (Pa, hPa or kPa), otherwise sea level is assumed.
  • Comma, semicolon or tab separated. Headers are matched by name: “dry”/“DB”, “RH”/“humid”, “dew”, “wet”/“WB”, “month”, “press”.
EPW files for most locations are free at climate.onebuilding.org.

3. Site

Design condition (extreme)

Two coincident design cases. Case A: the extreme dry-bulb with the wet-bulb of the hottest hour. Case B: the extreme wet-bulb with the dry-bulb of the most humid hour. Leave blank to use the ASHRAE extreme annual values (for an uploaded file: its hottest and most humid hours). Enter a stricter value, e.g. the ASHRAE 20-year return period, to replace the extreme.
Utility tariffs (running cost)
Running cost of cooling only (not the IT load). The demand charge is applied to the cooling electrical peak every month. Indicative defaults; enter the local tariff.
Chillers (ASHRAE 90.1-2025 Path B / AHRI 551/591)
Rated COP: ASHRAE 90.1-2025 Table 6.8.1-3, Path B full load, at AHRI 551/591 (7 °C chilled water; 35 °C air or 30 °C condenser water). Part load: VSD curve calibrated to the Path B IPLV. The number of duty units follows the unit size; units are staged by load (the next starts above 90% PLR), plus 1 standby per loop in the cost. Air-cooled capacity loss from public Trane RTAC data; units sized at Case A. Above the condenser-water limit a system is flagged, not excluded.
Heat rejection
Approaches: ASHRAE 90.1-2025 Table 6.8.1-7 rating points. Fan power at full speed: towers the ASHRAE 2025 minimum (3.56 L/s per kW); dry and adiabatic coolers 3% from public manufacturer data sheets. Fans on VFDs follow the affinity law (minimum speed 30%).
Pumps and fan wall units
P = Q × ΔP / (ρ × cp × ΔT × η). CDU pumps on a 10 K coolant ΔT; primary and secondary pumps on each loop's ΔT; condenser pumps on 5.56 K (211 kPa ≈ ASHRAE 90.1 Appendix G, 19 W/gpm). All pump and fan heat is added to the chiller load. VFD affinity law at part load (minimum speed 50% pumps, 30% fans).
Electrical losses
UPS losses apply to the IT load; transformer and distribution losses apply to the whole facility (IT + cooling). Used for the annual PUE only; electrical peaks are the cooling plant only. Cooling for electrical rooms is not included.
Initial cost rates ($ per kW of capacity)
Indicative installed rates for screening only. Replace with local quotes.

Equipment and cost

Strengths and watch-outs

Energy efficiency

MLC = annual mechanical energy ÷ annual cooling load (ASHRAE 90.4 definition, cooling load taken as IT energy). Maximum: ASHRAE 90.4-2022 Addendum g, Table 6.5, for the station's climate zone and ITE above / at or below 300 kW. Screening check: a compliance calculation follows the 90.4 load points and TMY3 weather. Free-cooling hours: chiller fully off.
Annual MLC

Electricity and water consumption

Annual totals at the frequent load. Peaks are the design peak: the higher of Case A and Case B at 100% load. Electrical peak = cooling only: chillers + heat-rejection fans + pumps + CRAH / FWU fans + CDU pumps (no IT load, no electrical equipment or losses). Water peak = make-up water (evaporation, blowdown, pad water). PUE = (IT + cooling + losses) ÷ IT, annual. CRAH / fan-wall fans are not included.

Method and equations

  • Weather: built-in cities use a measured typical year (TMYx 2011–2025) from the main airport station and ASHRAE 2025 Handbook of Fundamentals design conditions, both from climate.onebuilding.org. Hourly wet-bulb is limited to the ASHRAE extreme annual wet-bulb + 1 K. Psychrometrics per ASHRAE Fundamentals, Ch. 1.
  • Design cases: Case A = extreme dry-bulb + the wet-bulb of the hottest hour; Case B = extreme wet-bulb + the dry-bulb of the most humid hour. Every system is checked at both at 100% load; the design peak is the higher.
  • Loads: chiller load = IT load + CDU pumps or FWU fans + primary and secondary pumps. Pumps and fans: P = Q·ΔP / (ρ·cp·ΔT·η); VFD part load P = Pfull·(Q/Qdesign)³, minimum speed 50% pumps, 30% fans.
  • Free cooling = (Treturn − Tout) / (Treturn − Tsupply), 0–1. Tout: towers wb + 5.56 + 1.5 (plate HX); dry coolers db + 5.56 (direct on the loop); adiabatic wb + 11.1 + 1.5 with pads on (above 24 °C), db + 5.56 + 1.5 dry; hybrid: dry coolers alone up to 24 °C, towers above, dry share = (wb + 5.56 − db) / 5.56. Approaches: ASHRAE 90.1-2025 Table 6.8.1-7.
  • Chillers: COP = COPrated × [(Te + 273.15)/(Tc − Te)] ÷ [(Te,ref + 273.15)/(Tc,ref − Te,ref)], limited to 14. Te = supply − 2; Tc = db + 15 (air-cooled) or condenser water + 7 (water-cooled). Rated COP: ASHRAE 90.1-2025 Path B (2.866 air-cooled, 6.018 water-cooled) at AHRI 551/591 (Te,ref 5 °C; Tc,ref 50 / 37 °C). Part load: a + b·PLR + c·PLR² calibrated to the Path B IPLV (water-cooled 0.1969 / 0.1318 / 0.6713; air-cooled 0.1752 / 0.1354 / 0.6895). Units staged by load, the next above 90% PLR. Air-cooled capacity −1.35% per K above 35 °C.
  • Heat rejection: Qr = chiller load + chiller power. Fans at full speed: towers 1.2%, dry and adiabatic coolers 3% of the heat (ASHRAE 2025 minimum / public data sheets); condenser pumps 211 kPa on 5.56 K. Condenser water above 43 °C gives a warning (a chiller rated above 43 °C is needed).
  • Water: towers 0.00153 × flow × range evaporation (ASHRAE) plus blowdown at CoC 4 = 1.76 L/h per kW rejected; hybrid on the towers' share; adiabatic Qr × (db − Tpad) / (12 × 2,430) × 1.15 with pads on.
  • MLC (ASHRAE 90.4): annual mechanical energy ÷ annual IT energy; checked against ASHRAE 90.4-2025 Table 6.5 for the climate zone.
  • Electrical losses and PUE: PUE = (IT / ηUPS + cooling) / (1 − losses) / IT, UPS 96%, distribution 2%. Simplified, not the 90.4 ELC method.
  • Running cost: electricity × tariff + water × tariff + cooling peak × demand charge × 12. Simple payback against air-cooled chillers = extra initial cost (mid estimate) ÷ running cost saved.
  • Recommendation: energy 4, water 3 (doubled when water is limited), peak 3, initial cost 2, normalised across feasible options. Full basis: the Cooling Plant Calculation Basis. Screening-level; confirm with vendor selections.
